summary: Ruthenium (Ru) thin films were deposited using plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) with IMBCHRu as a precursor and N2/H2 plasma as a reactant. The study investigated the effects of varying the N2/H2 gas ratio on the properties of the Ru films, including resistivity, crystallinity, and microstructure. The films showed low resistivity and good step coverage, making them suitable for applications as a seed layer for Cu electroplating.
